issue.title: Qualify unresolved [[task-drawer]] and [[task-type]] links in decisions:capture-sigils-say-where-what-how
issue.description: Reproduced on master 4422abcc by bob-cli-fv.land: `sase memory init --no-commit` warns 'unresolved memory link [[task-drawer]] (did you mean glossary:task-drawer)' and '[[task-type]] (did you mean ... glossary:task-type ...)' for sase/memory/decisions/capture-sigils-say-where-what-how.md lines 19-20. The bare links were introduced by e660c8d8 (glued #drawer capture); inside a decisions strand an unqualified [[...]] resolves within the decisions web, so they must name the glossary web. Fix is mechanical link qualification only, no change to the record's claim; because decision records are immutable once accepted, get Bryan's explicit OK via /sase_memory_write, then run sase memory init and just docs-gen/docs-check if docs/develop/decisions.md regenerates.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Replace [[task-drawer]] with [[glossary:task-drawer]] and [[task-type]] with [[glossary:task-type]] on lines 19-20; change nothing else in the accepted body.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-fv.8 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3) during the gcal description bullets landing; sase memory init warns on every run about these two unresolved links, which bob-cli-fv's memory authorization did not cover.
